_about: Hand-reviewed list of blue carbon projects from the Berkeley Voluntary Registry Offsets Database (v2026-08). Every location is derived from open data: a Renoster boundary, a place named in the project's own title or site field (GeoNames), a state (Natural Earth), or only the country. Nothing is placed from memory. Edit this file to add, exclude or relocate projects, then run build_projects.py.
